subject: Silverline x Redwood marketplace preview — need to rebalance demo slot
content:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@silverline.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Silverline x Redwood marketplace preview — need to rebalance demo slot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for lining up the marketplace preview. We had a last-minute regional enablement for our APAC SIs and several folks who planned to attend the demo are now double-booked on the 11th. Would you be able to rebalance the session to the 13th (Friday) or the following Tuesday (17th)? Prefer a late APAC slot (UTC+5:30 / 09:30-12:30 SGT window).

Attached is the latest agenda (Silverline_Redwood_Agenda_v2.pdf) — we tightened the SI-run section and added an ask on marketplace listing metadata. If we move dates I want to ensure our SI lead and the AWS partner rep can join.

Amit
Partner GTM, Silverline Systems
(attachments: Silverline_Redwood_Agenda_v2.pdf)

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@silverline.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Silverline x Redwood marketplace preview — need to rebalance demo slot

Thanks for the heads up, Amit — totally understand. Friday the 13th could work for our team but Vanessa (technical host) is limited in the morning PT; the 17th is preferable from our side.

Proposed options (convert to APAC times for the SI):
- Option A: Fri 2026-08-13, 09:30 SGT / 21:00 PT (short window for Vanessa to join)
- Option B: Tue 2026-08-17, 10:30 SGT / 22:00 PT (preferred — allows full runbook)

Vanessa + Rishi: can you confirm host availability for Option B? If yes I will send a calendar invite and share the marketplace preview link and the tech runbook. Priya — can you confirm AWS co-sell presence for the 17th?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit.shah@silverline.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverline x Redwood marketplace preview — need to rebalance demo slot

Karthik — Option B (17th) works for me. I’ve confirmed with our infra team and we can dedicate a technical host and a mini-runbook for the SI portion. I attached a quick screenshot of the marketplace preview page and the call flow I want to follow (marketplace_preview-screenshot.png).

Two asks before I lock the invite:
1) Can Silverline share the SI lead's email and their preferred timezone so I can include them in the runbook dry-run?
2) Any compliance items to surface to our Private deployment PM ahead of the joint demo (data retention question that came up last run)?

Vanessa Ortiz
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
(attachments: marketplace_preview-screenshot.png)

From: Priya Nair <priya.nair@aws-partner.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@silverline.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:54:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverline x Redwood marketplace preview — need to rebalance demo slot

Quick note from AWS side — we have an APAC partner summit the week of the 17th and several of our regional account SAs will be on travel. If the Silverline SI lead can do a short asynchronous pre-recorded runthrough and then a live Q&A on the 17th, we can still support the co-hosting.

Two options that keep momentum:
- Live Q&A only: Tue 17 Aug, 11:00 SGT (30–45 min) — we join for Q&A and handoff to SI folks.
- Full live run: Wed 18 Aug, 09:30 SGT — AWS will commit technical presence.

If you prefer the 17th, we can accept a 20–30 minute live slot with prerecord from Silverline. I’ve pasted the partner summit agenda link here for visibility: https://events.aws.example/apac-partner-summit (FYI only).

Priya Nair
AWS Partner Development

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@silverline.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@aws-partner.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Silverline x Redwood marketplace preview — need to rebalance demo slot

All — thanks for the fast replies. Let’s lock Option B with the live Q&A cadence to keep the AWS presence (per Priya) and reduce travel pressure:

- Pre-record (Silverline) due: Mon 2026-08-15, 23:59 SGT
- Live Q&A (Redwood + AWS + SI): Tue 2026-08-17, 11:00 SGT / 22:00 PT (30–45 min)
- Full technical follow-up (optional): Wed 2026-08-18, 09:30 SGT if AWS can join for a deeper run

Amit — can you confirm your SI lead and drop the prerecord by the 15th? Vanessa — I’ll send the invite today with the runbook attached and include the marketplace preview link: https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/silverline-preview. I’ll also add a short checklist for Private deployment flagging (Rishi — would you add the retention note in the runbook?).

Once Amit confirms SI contact I’ll send the calendar invite and a short Doc with the agenda (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abc-demo-agenda).

Appreciate the flexibility — will ping if anything else blocks.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
